newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hoogovens says most 1997 acquisitions already done.
newsitem.headline: Hoogovens says most 1997 acquisitions already done.

text.p: Steel and aluminium group Hoogovens NV said on Thursday the bulk of its acquisitions for 1997 had been completed in the first quarter.
Earlier on Thursday Hoogovens said investment expenditure in 1997 -- both capital spending and acquisitions -- would be substantially higher than in 1996.

But it said the 1997 acquisitions programme had been largely implemented following the recent acquisition of 50 percent of Belgian steel firm UGB and the purchase of the remaining 50 percent of steel-coating firm Hille & Mueller.

"Our acquisition plans have already been realised to a large extent. I would not rule out further acquisitions...but they will definitely not be on the same scale," chairman Maarten van Veen told a news conference on the group's 1996 results.
